chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the infinite nature of divine favors (ni'mah) that defy enumeration. It serves not only as a call to gratitude but also as a subtle reminder of the transient nature of worldly blessings compared to eternal divine grace, urging believers to reflect on their spiritual accountability.
